label: Every CONTINGENCY_1 being at w is corruptible simply or under some power over its esse
paraphrase: OPEN (PGP, power grounding of possible non-existence), analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every candidate contingent at w either can fail to be in substance (CanFailToBe x esse, the existing DEF-CAN-FAIL-TO-BE primitive at the respect of being, read as corruptible simply: an intrinsic two-way potency to be and not be, not the bare possibility of not being) or has some being, possibly itself, with power over its esse (PowerOver y x esse: y can give or withhold, make or unmake x's being). Its content: an actual individual's possible non-existence is some power's potentiality, a passive potency in the thing or an active power over its being. It concerns only the possible absence of an actual individual, not alien or global possibilities. Self-power is allowed, so a self-annihilating being satisfies it.
